text:
anita: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: pricing & usage policy. Capturing Qs that came up so we can close the loop. Main points: per-route visibility vs billing buckets, ratecap exemptions, and how burst/grace behavior works.

liam: Short answer: billing units = tokens at org/project level. Console shows per-route breakdown for visibility and troubleshooting, but not separate invoicing.

sasha: Finance: we don't create per-route billing buckets by default. Customers who need separate invoices should work with RevOps to set up multiple orgs/accounts. One-off credit grants require finance approval.

kevin: Ops: exemptions live as a flag in the control plane. Right now it's manual (support -> ops flips flag). No self-serve UI yet.

anita: Customers asked about turnaround for exemptions — some expect <24h. What's realistic?

kevin: SLA targets: enterprise/existing accounts = 24h, standard = 48h. For urgent partner integrations we can issue temporary burst tokens (time-limited) while exemption is processed.

liam: Burst mechanics: token-bucket limiter with ~30s burst capacity by default. Short bursts allowed; sustained bursts trigger backpressure and 429s. Dedicated/Dedicated customers can request custom rate-limit profiles.

sasha: "Grace credits" note: we don't auto-apply goodwill credits. Sales/revops may request adjustments, finance approves. I'll create a standard approval template.

maria: Roadmap: self-serve exemption UI and per-route billing on the roadmap. We'll add an engineering RFC this sprint; tentative public ETA Q3 for the UI.

anita: Action items: liam - RFC + doc stub; kevin - emergency runbook; sasha - finance approval template. Can deploy-bot create a docs stub?

deploy-bot: docs: /docs/ops/credits-exemptions.md created by liam - https://redwood.docs/credits-exemptions

anita: Please include a sample config snippet showing `rate_limit_exempt: true // per-org`. That helps partners and SREs.

liam: Will do. Full examples + caveats will be in the doc.

kevin: I'll also add steps for issuing & revoking temporary burst keys to the runbook.

sasha: Sharing finance template in #finance-review for legal+sales signoff.

anita: Thanks all. I'll add this to the all-hands notes and schedule a follow-up thread to confirm timelines.
